description: This Python script generates human-readable reports from MISP security event data, supporting input from remote events or files, and formatting output in AsciiDoc.

classes.name: ReportGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates reports from MISP events, either fetched remotely or loaded from files, and formats them as AsciiDoc.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report generator with a profile, loading the corresponding template module.

methods.name: from_remote
methods.description: Fetches a MISP event by ID from a remote server and loads it into the object.

methods.name: from_file
methods.description: Loads a MISP event from a specified file.

methods.name: attributes
methods.description: Extracts and formats attributes and objects from the MISP event for the report.

methods.name: _get_tag_info
methods.description: Reverts a machine tag to its taxonomy information.

methods.name: report_headers
methods.description: Adds header information to the report, including organization name and date.

methods.name: event_level_tags
methods.description: Extracts TLP tags from the event and formats them.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Generates the report title using internal IDs, event info, and summaries.

methods.name: asciidoc
methods.description: Builds the complete AsciiDoc report content.
